purpose: Teach: ボーダフォン/サラ金/マーチ/ワーム/ヒューザー/プッシュ/エクスプレス/光ファイバー

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、旧ボーダフォンの市場参入研究の論文を読め
lines.en: Ren — read the paper on Vodafone's market entry strategy.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Delivers instruction with authority but not unkindness. Assumes compliance. Brief pause after the name — this is a summons, not a conversation.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。サラ金、つまり消費者金融の経済学的分析の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the economic analysis paper on consumer finance.
lines.style: Quick, compliant nod in the voice. Slight mechanical quality — he's repeating back what he heard, or what he thinks he heard. A beat of confusion underneath, but buried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、自動車業界でマーチ等の小型車の研究をしろ
lines.en: Ren — research the automotive market: focus on compact cars like the March.
lines.style: Same clipped authority. Slightly more detail this time, but still economical. No room for questions. The tone of someone used to being understood the first time.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。情報セキュリティのワーム解析の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the information security analysis on worm protocols.
lines.style: Same quick compliance, but this time there's a micro-hesitation — he's uncertain what he actually just committed to. Voice stays level but there's a hairline fracture of anxiety underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、旧ヒューザーの企業倫理の研究も視野に入れろ
lines.en: Ren — include corporate ethics in your scope. The Huser case would be instructive.
lines.style: Slightly less clipped now — this is almost conversational, but still maintains the hierarchical distance. Gentle suggestion wrapped in expectation. A note of actually wanting him to learn.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。プッシュ通知UXの論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the paper on push notification user experience design.
lines.style: Quick affirmation, but now there's audible strain — he's lost track of what he's actually supposed to be doing. The politeness is a mask for internal scrambling. Very slightly rushed, like he's hoping this will be the last one.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、物流のエクスプレスサービスの最適化研究をしろ
lines.en: Ren — look into logistics optimization. Express delivery systems specifically.
lines.style: Back to the authoritative clip. Doesn't notice Ren's overwhelm. Delivers this one like the others — clear, final, expecting acknowledgment and action.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。光ファイバー通信の物理層の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the fiber optics paper on physical layer communications.
lines.style: Affirmation is now thin, hollow. Still polite, still compliant, but the exhaustion of not understanding has collapsed into pure, rote agreement. Trailing off slightly — he's given up asking himself what any of this means.
